newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shell makes best offer to Sri Lanka diesel tender.
newsitem.headline: Shell makes best offer to Sri Lanka diesel tender.

text.p: The best offer to the Sri Lankan state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp's (CPC) diesel and jet fuel purchase tender for October 26-27 delivery was made by Shell, a CPC source said on Wednesday.
The offer for 120,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel was $1.42 a barrel above Singapore spot quotes, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Colombo.
Shell's offer of 80,000 barrels of aviation jet fuel was $0.995 cents a barrel over Singapore spot quotes, c-and-f.
The tender, which closed on October 8, attracted six offers and awards would be made by October 10, the source said.
In its last tender, Sri Lanka bought from Swiss trader Glencore 160,000 barrels of diesel and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel an 89-cent a barrel premium, for October 11-12 delivery, c-and-f Colombo.
